description: Nova Syndicate is a group with Artificial Intelligence Software Development students at Motheo TVET College with a focus on Machine Learning, Deep Learning and Data Science. We turn complex data to trustworthy tools that make people make better decisions. We have a simple approach : ask a question,investigate trends, let the evidence decide and build solutions.
summary:
AstroHealth is research prototype for continuous astronaut health monitoring on long duration missions. It addresses the challenge theme of monitoring the health and psychological and mental health indicators during long duration travel. 

This project can catch avoidable decline sooner, such  as under-eating, and flag poor sleep, stress and isolation early. weight loss is linked to extra bone and muscle loss, so acting earlier may help.
details:
AstroHealth compares each astronaut with their own 14-day baseline and watches two kinds of deterioration. Fast signals appear in hours: heart rate, HRV, SpO2, blood pressure, breathing and temperature. Slow signals build over days or weeks: sleep, stress, isolation, nutrition and weight, and radiation. Combined shifts across several signals trigger one of four alert levels (green, yellow, orange, red). Every alert says what happened, why it matters and what to do next. The dashboard has an interactive body diagram, early-detection, Mind and Sleep, Nutrition and Mental Health Help tabs, an emergency simulation, and a crew overview that ranks who needs attention first.

AstroHealth adds a combining and early-warning layer on top of what NASA already does, so avoidable decline can be caught while there is still time to act.

Initially we planned to use python to build our system. Sqlite3 for storing data, streamlite for app and dashboard, pandas, numpy and scipy for data analysis. We couldn't really deploy our "python made" dashboard so we decided to create a simulation using html, css and Java script. The backend is python only with pandas, Sqlite3, Flutter and pandas. We hope if we get considered for the global selection, we'll get mentored and guided to create a full working solution.

Our system is unique. It's not like any other system that shows the health vitals of a patient /astronaut. We just incorporated a normal health monitoring system but we added a tiered crew alert option which we called "crew buddy" where if a crewmates health declines, the people nearby can help, without exposing private health data. A question was asked by a judge that involved mental health, so we decided to add a mental health window to health astronauts to cope with isolation, stress, anxiety, panic attacks, sleep deprivation and depression, it has a mood check in guide, option to request a doctor/psychologist and breathing exercises.

After we conducted our research, we found a number of factors that our system can address, weight and bone loss, psychological and mental illnesses, radiation, weakening of the immune system, the effect of gravity on the brain, isolation and oxygen levels in the space ship.

AstroHealth is not about curing astronauts, but instead it is here to aid astronauts and doctors on earth to detect early signs of an unhealthy immune system and mental health . I believe that AstroHealth is what NASA needs for their mission to go to Mars.
